narration.text: Before we go further you need one word: arbitrage. It simply means buying something in one market and selling it in another for more.

slot_term.definition: Buying something in one market and selling it in another for more, pocketing the difference.

narration.text: The second word is longer and has no pronunciation guide, so the card has to stand on the word and its meaning alone.

slot_term.definition: The ability of two different systems to work together without anyone rebuilding either one.
